# Event_Based_Tracking_Baseline

**Domain**: iNEST
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-08-04

## Definition
A standardized spiking neural network architecture and training pipeline that serves as a reference benchmark for event-based single-object tracking. Provides a reproducible baseline for comparing future SNN tracking methods, accelerating progress in neuromorphic vision applications.
